'''I-C2 Civil-Industrial Droids''' were [[EVS Construction Droid|construction droids]] from [[Veril Line Systems/Legends|Veril Line Systems]]. Ten [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and thirty meters long, they were box-like in shape and moved on heavy-duty treaded wheels. They were equipped with a processing furnace, multiple lifting/repair [[Limb/Legends|appendages]], a [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]], and an audio receiver. They cost 1,700,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new (975,000 used). The model was meant to replace the [[EVS Construction Droid]], being less expensive, smaller, with more sophisticated programming, and greater independence and situation-assessment capability. The model was popular in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].
